domain_resolution.opening_values: optical median improvements present; radar precursor/trial only at opening

opening_values.1942_highgrade_result: high-grade Japanese operational cryptosystem largely denies US short-strategy-time reconstruction; residual low-grade/plaintext/traffic/DF/recon remain

entries.what_changed: Protection/reliability is modeled as transition probabilities among healthy, localized damage, degraded function, mission kill, immobile and loss states.
combat_meaning: Small hit-probability changes may create large operational differences when they cross mission-kill or repair thresholds.

entries.what_changed: Calculated design improvements are allowed to consume safety margin only as test/sister-unit reproducibility matures.
combat_meaning: Keeps early calculation gains from becoming instant fleet-wide optimized production while allowing repeated evidence to improve standard design.

entries.what_changed: Effects at distinct causal stages may compound; effects feeding the same intermediate state are integrated there first. Thresholds and reallocation can amplify modest component changes.
combat_meaning: Avoids both unconditional percentage multiplication and the opposite error of treating all improvements as isolated increments.

entries.what_changed: Nominal hull/airframe existence is not combat power. Evaluate Hull/airframe -> Availability -> Mission set -> Mission effectiveness -> Allocation.
combat_meaning: Prevents paper OOB and headline performance from being treated as available combat force.

entries.what_changed: Optical glass characterization and production control reduce lot-to-lot refractive/dispersion variance and assembly error.
combat_meaning: Improves consistency of rangefinding/night observation/photo/periscope systems; combat effectiveness still depends on crew/weather/I-O.

entries.what_changed: Optical glass/process/statistical calibration improves production median and lot uniformity of rangefinders/night optics more than best-case theoretical resolution.

magnitude.range: large rangefinder device variation -10% to -20%; total ranging error -5% to -8%; calibration time -20% to -30%; completed optical performance variation -30% to -50%

combat_meaning: More units deliver near-designed ranging/identification performance and recover calibration faster.

entries.what_changed: Radar provides meaningful rough detection/early warning but remains a human-mediated input into plotting, optical confirmation and fire control.

magnitude.range: applicable practical detection may improve ~5-15%; primary value is non-optical warning input, not automatic accuracy

combat_meaning: Can buy warning minutes and recover contact in poor visibility; does not automatically identify, solve motion, direct CAP or guarantee gunfire.

entries.what_changed: Radar range, optical bearing, track prediction, multiple-target management and fighter/fire-control direction can approach a tactical closed loop.
entries.warning: Indexed but not mature for this event date; do not back-port.

entries.valid_from: from actual radar fielding date, equipment dependent
entries.what_changed: Computation/testing reduces calibration error, device variance and development iteration; initial operational radar units are more repeatable than historical equivalents.

magnitude.range: test iteration -30% to -50%; performance variation -30% to -40%; initial availability +15% to +25% relative; calibration error -30% to -50%; practical detection distance +5% to +15% where same principle/hardware applies

combat_meaning: Fielded sets work more often and deliver more consistent ranges, but human I/O and doctrine still bound tactical use.

entries.valid_from: improving at opening; more mature through 1942 and after carrier-battle lessons
entries.what_changed: Search evolves from single-pass sector search toward broad search, suspicious-contact revisit, fast confirmation, tracking and later position update.
combat_meaning: Raises chance that ambiguous sightings become timely actionable tracks instead of expiring observations.

entries.what_changed: Japanese high-grade operational cryptosystems plus key/traffic discipline prevent the US from normally reconstructing location, exact schedule and force composition from high-grade ciphertext with short-strategic timeliness/precision.

magnitude.range: high-grade content near-unavailable for short-strategic exploitation; not mathematical/permanent impossibility

combat_meaning: Historical JN-25-like content advantages must not be silently reinserted into US pre-battle knowledge.

entries.valid_from: opening onward; improves with Type2P/Type3 later
entries.what_changed: Japanese cryptanalysis primarily exploits low/mid-grade codes, traffic analysis, DF, plaintext and operational mistakes; SIGABA-class highest-grade traffic is not routinely broken.
combat_meaning: Provides probabilistic operational warning and short exploitation windows rather than omniscient reading of Allied plans.

entries.what_changed: Unreadable high-grade content does not remove low-grade codes, plaintext, peripheral traffic, traffic volume, callsigns/frequencies, DF, air/sub reconnaissance, geography and logistics inference.
combat_meaning: Enemy can form candidate-operation probabilities and rough force/activity estimates but with worse precision/freshness.

entries.what_changed: Central cryptographic computing/card-statistical capability is already present and used for design testing, key-usage audit and traffic statistics.

range.1941_end: Type 2 ~3-5, Type 1C ~5-10 plus multiple card rooms (scenario center estimates)

combat_meaning: Raises cipher-design/operations quality and analytic throughput but remains constrained by distribution, operators, captures and radio traffic.

entries.what_changed: Information acquisition, analyst confidence, headquarters acceptance, decision and field execution are separate states.
combat_meaning: A cryptanalytic or reconnaissance warning changes history only if it remains timely and is believed/acted on.

entries.what_changed: Many surface-ship speed benefits appear as higher probability of making planned speed under load, fouling, fatigue and continuous operations rather than trial-speed increase.

magnitude.range: class-specific; headline maximum change often small

combat_meaning: Can decide arrival/interception/re-entry thresholds even when trial-speed delta is small.
do_not_simplify_as: irrelevant because maximum speed changed little

entries.what_changed: The largest calculation benefit in naval gunfire is reduction of initial systematic error under long-range/nonstandard meteorological conditions.
combat_meaning: May materially improve opening salvos without changing the fundamental salvo-observe-correct cycle.

entries.what_changed: Better calculation, calibration, optics and I/O shorten convergence of existing mechanical fire-control cycles; they do not replace them.
combat_meaning: Earlier/more reliable effective fire, especially with nonstandard initial conditions.
do_not_simplify_as: electronic replacement of mechanical fire control

entries.valid_from: opening for Asashio-class in applicable material state
entries.what_changed: Asashio-class design/production median emphasizes restored structural margin, machinery/vibration reliability and repeatable real speed/range rather than extra weapons.

magnitude.range: trial speed 34.7-34.9 kt center 34.8; range 4,800-4,900 nmi/18 kt; future topweight margin +15-20 t class

combat_meaning: More ships meet planned movement/fuel schedules and return for subsequent missions; headline speed gain is secondary.
do_not_simplify_as: paper top speed equals operational value

entries.valid_from: class/refit specific; opening strongest in computation-designed later classes
entries.what_changed: Weight/strength calculation savings are reinvested in local reinforcement, drainage/firefighting, power/ventilation, steering and reserve margin rather than pure lightening.

magnitude.range: class specific; do not use one fleet multiplier

combat_meaning: Can reduce transition from moderate damage to mission kill and preserve function after non-catastrophic hits.
do_not_simplify_as: survival bonus multiplied again with firing-continuity bonus

entries.what_changed: Computing-assisted design yields modest headline speed gains but stronger range, stability, reliability and planned-speed realization in Asashio/Kagero lineage.
combat_meaning: Operational value is schedule/intercept/re-entry robustness rather than a large universal knot advantage.

entries.valid_from: opening for Kagero-class and descendants where configuration matches
entries.what_changed: Kagero-class reaches planned 35-kt class performance with improved cruising efficiency and reduced early machinery/yard downtime variation.

magnitude.range: trial 35.4-35.7 kt; practical full-load max 34.6-34.9 kt; range ~5,300 nmi/18 kt; initial machinery faults -15% to -25%; unplanned yard days first two years -10% to -20%

combat_meaning: Long-range approach, high-speed entry, withdrawal and re-sortie can compound into materially higher effective force availability.
do_not_simplify_as: 0.3 kt headline difference is the whole effect

entries.what_changed: Abnormal runs/start failures, fuze technical failures and routine oxygen-handling accidents have a reduced long-tail failure distribution.

magnitude.range: abnormal/start failures -15% to -25%; fuze technical failures -15% to -25%; routine oxygen accidents -20% to -30%

combat_meaning: Improves salvo realized weapon count and handling reliability without changing enemy evasion.

entries.valid_from: 1941-42 first-line torpedo stocks and calibrated launch systems; lot-specific
entries.what_changed: Type 93/95 nominal speed/range/warhead remain historical-class, while technical straight-running/depth dispersion, lot variation and ship/tube calibration variation are reduced.

magnitude.range: weapon technical dispersion -15% to -25%; lot variation -25% to -40%; ship/tube calibration variation -25% to -40%

combat_meaning: Raises the fraction of salvos not wasted by technical error before enemy maneuver dominates; strongest at shorter/stable engagements.

entries.valid_from: 1939-41 doctrine integration for equipped first-line units
entries.what_changed: Reliability engineering removes the long failure tail of reload machinery so reload/re-entry can be scheduled in suitable engagements.

range.first_launch_to_second_effective_salvo: 12-20 min class for mature units; early Kagero may be 15-25

combat_meaning: In 20-60 minute actions, carried reload torpedoes have much higher probability of becoming real combat firepower.

entries.valid_from: late 1930s-1941 first-line units after calibration/training maturation
entries.what_changed: Ship/launcher/gyro/lot calibration and fire-control error are reduced; useful-range practical effectiveness rises.

magnitude.range: same-condition practical hit rate broadly +10-25% relative; refined working sensitivity is smaller at long range/alerted maneuvering targets

combat_meaning: More useful torpedoes per firing opportunity; long range remains strongly target-motion limited.
